name: Girls! Girls! Girls!?
source:
Akihabara, the electric town – hub for state-of-the-art technology, fashion, otaku goods, and the cutest boys in skirts you'll ever see.
Pop in to the Girls! Girls! Girls!? Cafe and fall in love with one of four charming "ladies..." or maybe even all of them? Jump into a story full of fluff, romance, friendship, and crossdressing that'll keep you coming back for more!
